title: Provisioning Standard for New Web Hosting Plans Orders
content:
**Web Hosting Plans — provisioning standard.**

A paid order is provisioned within the tier's provisioning deadline in elapsed hours of the order, and the plan becomes active on the date provisioning completes. An order that fails payment or fraud screening is never provisioned and is cancelled, and every purchase line of it, setup fee included, is refunded in full as a failed order to the original payment method. A plan provisioned later than its deadline is a Harborline service failure that the Harborline Customer Accounts goodwill rule may recognise, and lateness never moves the term dates, which still count from the order date.

| Order outcome | Plan | Purchase lines |
|---|---|---|
| paid, provisioned within the deadline | active from the date provisioning completes | kept |
| paid, provisioned after the deadline | active from the date provisioning completes; term dates still count from the order date | kept |
| failed payment or fraud screening | never provisioned, cancelled | all refunded in full as a failed order, setup fee included, to the original payment method |

**Example (hypothetical).** An order placed at 09:10 on a tier with a 2-hour deadline is due to be provisioned by 11:10 that day; if provisioning completes at 13:40, the plan is active from that date, its term still counts from the order date, and the lateness is a service failure the goodwill rule may recognise.
